name: Finger Lakes Boating Museum
description: Dedicated to the boating heritage of the Finger Lakes, the museum showcases dozens of historically significant wooden boats, restored runabouts, and period outboard motors in a purpose-built facility directly across from Pleasant Valley Winery on Keuka Lake.

name: Yates County History Center
hoursNote: Closed major holidays and when local schools are closed due to weather. Group tours by appointment.
description: Three-museum campus anchored by the 1852 Oliver House, an 18-room Italianate Victorian mansion with original period furnishings, Native American exhibits, and rotating local history galleries. Free admission with guided tours available.

name: Garrett Memorial Chapel
hoursNote: Seasonal June–September only; open Tues & Thurs 1–4 pm. Sunday nondenominational worship services July 4–Labor Day at 9 am. Grounds open during visiting hours; free admission.
description: Norman Gothic limestone chapel built in 1931 by wine magnate Paul Garrett as a memorial to his son, listed on the National Register of Historic Places and commanding panoramic views of Keuka Lake from the Bluff Point peninsula.

name: Greyton H. Taylor Wine Museum
address: 8843 Greyton H. Taylor Memorial Drive, Hammondsport, NY 14840
description: Founded in 1972 by Walter S. Taylor on the original Taylor family winery site, the museum complex includes a Cooper Shop replica, two centuries of wine-making artifacts, and the Walter S. Taylor Art Gallery featuring the founder's distinctive folk-art paintings.

name: Saunders Finger Lakes Museum
hoursNote: Indoor exhibit building under construction; 30-acre outdoor campus open dawn–dusk year-round with wetland boardwalks, nature trails, and lakeside pavilion. Seasonal guided programs available.
description: Museum-in-development on a 30-acre lakeside campus at the north end of Keuka Lake offering wetland boardwalks, nature trails, and year-round ecological and cultural heritage programs about the Finger Lakes region.
